lines.zh: 我迈不出去，这条腿是固定的。
lines.en: I can't take a step; this leg is fixed in place.

lines.zh: 我的底座钉在地上，动不了。
lines.en: My base is bolted down. I can't move.

lines.zh: 要是能走，我想先去看看走廊。
lines.en: If I could walk, I'd go see the corridor first.

lines.zh: 我整个人被摆成了行走的姿势。
lines.en: I'm posed mid-stride, but only posed.

lines.zh: 脚尖朝着门，可我一步也没走过。
lines.en: My toes point at the door, and I've never walked to it.

lines.zh: 有人搬动我时，我才算移了位置。
lines.en: I only move when someone carries me.

lines.zh: 地板离我的脚有一指宽。
lines.en: The floor sits a finger's width below my feet.

lines.zh: 我这条腿抬着，永远落不下去。
lines.en: This leg is raised, and it will never land.

lines.zh: 走动是别人的事，我只管站着。
lines.en: Walking is for others. I only stand.

lines.zh: 我听见有人走过的声音，很近。
lines.en: I hear someone walking past, quite near.

lines.zh: 装成正要迈步，是摆我的人的主意。
lines.en: Posing me mid-step was whoever set me here.

lines.zh: 我这姿势摆了太久，关节都僵了。
lines.en: I've held this pose so long my joints have set.

lines.zh: 我一站就是一整天。
lines.en: I stand for a whole day at a stretch.

lines.zh: 灰尘在我肩上积了一层。
lines.en: Dust has gathered on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着前面那面墙。
lines.en: My eyes are fixed on the wall ahead.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，因为没有必要。
lines.en: I don't blink. There's no need.

lines.zh: 有人从我面前走过，没看我。
lines.en: Someone passed in front of me without a glance.

lines.zh: 我的手臂举着，放不下来。
lines.en: My arm is raised and can't come down.

lines.zh: 这间屋子我看了几千遍。
lines.en: I've looked at this room thousands of times.

lines.zh: 我听见屋顶漏水，滴在同一个地方。
lines.en: A leak drips on the same spot overhead.

lines.zh: 油漆剥落的地方，露出底下的灰。
lines.en: Where the paint peeled, gray shows through.

lines.zh: 我的笑容是画上去的，擦不掉。
lines.en: My smile is painted on. It won't wipe off.

lines.zh: 静止也是一种表演。
lines.en: Stillness is a performance too.

lines.zh: 我在等有人把我搬到别处。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone to move me elsewhere.

lines.zh: 空气里有股旧木头味。
lines.en: The air smells of old timber.

lines.zh: 光从窗缝里斜过来，正好照到我。
lines.en: Light slants through a gap and lands on me.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，我看见了。
lines.en: You're standing before me. I see you.

lines.zh: 我转不了头，只能用眼角。
lines.en: I can't turn my head, only use the corner of my eye.

lines.zh: 你比摆我的人高一点。
lines.en: You're a little taller than whoever set me here.

lines.zh: 你伸手摸我，我无所谓。
lines.en: You're reaching for me. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我这身皮是布做的，别使劲。
lines.en: This hide is cloth. Don't pull hard.

lines.zh: 你要是喜欢，就多看两眼。
lines.en: If you like it, look a while longer.

lines.zh: 我从没跟人说过话，你是第一个。
lines.en: I've never spoken to anyone. You're the first.

lines.zh: 你在找出口吗？门在我身后。
lines.en: Looking for the exit? The door's behind me.

lines.zh: 别推我，我会倒的。
lines.en: Don't push me. I'd fall.

lines.zh: 我的帽子有点歪，你能扶一下吗？
lines.en: My hat's crooked. Could you straighten it?

lines.zh: 你这身装备，是来探险的？
lines.en: Dressed like that — exploring?

lines.zh: 我在这儿站了很多年，没人问过。
lines.en: I've stood here years and no one's asked.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我脚上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my feet.

lines.zh: 你说话，我听着，虽然我不能点头。
lines.en: Talk; I'm listening, even if I can't nod.

lines.zh: 这个角度，我能看见你的眼睛。
lines.en: At this angle I can see your eyes.

lines.zh: 你走开的时候，我会一直看着。
lines.en: When you leave, I'll still be looking.

lines.zh: 展览品不太会聊天，请见谅。
lines.en: Exhibits aren't much for conversation. Forgive me.

lines.zh: 你身上有灰，跟这里一样。
lines.en: You're dusty, same as this place.

lines.zh: 我的布被划破了。
lines.en: My cloth has been cut.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，底座吱呀响。
lines.en: I rock, and my base creaks.

lines.zh: 我什么都做不了，只能挨着。
lines.en: There's nothing I can do but take it.

lines.zh: 里面的填充物掉出来了。
lines.en: The stuffing is coming out.

lines.zh: 别敲我胸口，里面是空心的布。
lines.en: Don't knock on my chest; it is hollow cloth inside.

lines.zh: 我的一条手臂歪了。
lines.en: One of my arms is bent wrong.

lines.zh: 痛不痛，我说不清。
lines.en: Whether it hurts, I can't say.

lines.zh: 灯泡松了，我的右眼灭了。
lines.en: The bulb loosens; my right eye goes dark.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的姿势变了。
lines.en: Now my pose has changed.

lines.zh: 没人会来修我。
lines.en: No one's coming to repair me.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我拿不了。
lines.en: That thing in your hand — I can't take it.

lines.zh: 我的手臂抬着，够不到。
lines.en: My arm is raised, and I can't reach.

lines.zh: 放我脚边吧，我看着就好。
lines.en: Set it at my feet. I'll just look.

lines.zh: 那颜色跟我的领结很配。
lines.en: That color goes with my bow tie.

lines.zh: 你举高些，我眼睛动不了。
lines.en: Hold it higher; my eyes can't move.

lines.zh: 我很久没见过新东西了。
lines.en: I haven't seen anything new in a long while.

lines.zh: 这套布景里，这个不搭。
lines.en: In this set, that doesn't belong.

lines.zh: 你摆在那边的架子上吧。
lines.en: Put it on that shelf over there.

lines.zh: 我看着它，就当是我的。
lines.en: I'll watch it and call it mine.

lines.zh: 这地方的东西，都归摆我的人。
lines.en: Everything here belongs to whoever set me up.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You touched me and I swayed.

lines.zh: 别推，我的底座不牢。
lines.en: Don't push. My base isn't firm.

lines.zh: 我倒过一次，被人扶起来了。
lines.en: I fell once and someone stood me back up.

lines.zh: 你踩在我的脚上了。
lines.en: You're standing on my foot.

lines.zh: 我这一身很轻，撞起来没声音。
lines.en: I'm light; bumping me makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我的手臂被你撞歪了。
lines.en: You knocked my arm askew.

lines.zh: 慢点走，这里摆着东西。
lines.en: Walk slowly. There are things set up here.

lines.zh: 往左一点，你会碰到我的帽子。
lines.en: A little to the left and you'll hit my hat.

lines.zh: 别靠着我休息，我会倒。
lines.en: Don't lean on me; I'd topple.

lines.zh: 你退开了，我又正过来了。
lines.en: You stepped away and I settled back straight.

lines.zh: 我连转身都做不到。
lines.en: I can't even turn around.

lines.zh: 展览品不谈这个。
lines.en: Exhibits don't discuss such things.

lines.zh: 我身边那个位置一直空着。
lines.en: The spot beside me has always been empty.

lines.zh: 要是有人给我做个伴，也不错。
lines.en: A companion would be nice, if someone made one.

lines.zh: 你愿意站在这儿陪我吗？
lines.en: Would you stand here with me?

lines.zh: 我们俩都不动，倒像一对。
lines.en: Neither of us moving — we'd look like a pair.

lines.zh: 我被摆成这个样子，很不合适。
lines.en: I'm posed badly for that.

lines.zh: 别把我和别的摆件凑一起。
lines.en: Don't pair me up with other ornaments.

lines.zh: 我这辈子只有这一个姿势。
lines.en: I have only this one pose in me.

lines.zh: 有人记得我就够了。
lines.en: Being remembered by someone is enough.

lines.zh: 我看见了，可捡不起来。
lines.en: I see it, but I can't pick it up.

lines.zh: 东西落在我脚边，我够不到。
lines.en: Something fell at my feet and I can't reach.

lines.zh: 我的手是固定的，张不开。
lines.en: My hand is fixed and won't open.

lines.zh: 谁掉的东西，就在我左手边。
lines.en: Whatever dropped is at my left hand.

lines.zh: 你帮我捡吧，我记你的情。
lines.en: Pick it up for me. I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币卡在我的底座下。
lines.en: A coin is wedged under my base.

lines.zh: 它在那儿待了整整一个雨季。
lines.en: It's sat there a whole rainy season.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，已经盯了很久。
lines.en: I've been staring at it a long while.

lines.zh: 有人捡走了，我就看不见了。
lines.en: Someone took it, so I can't see it now.

lines.zh: 放我手里也行，反正我不动。
lines.en: Put it in my hand. I won't move either way.

lines.zh: 别晃，我的眼睛不能转。
lines.en: Don't sway; my eyes can't turn.

lines.zh: 我盯住你了，虽然不能追。
lines.en: I've fixed on you, though I can't chase.

lines.zh: 你走进我的视野里了。
lines.en: You've stepped into my field of view.

lines.zh: 我这目光移不开，天生的。
lines.en: My gaze won't move. That's how I'm made.

lines.zh: 你在墙那边，我听得出。
lines.en: You're beyond the wall; I can tell.

lines.zh: 有人靠近，我只能看着。
lines.en: Someone's close. All I can do is watch.

lines.zh: 这一间屋里，只有你在动。
lines.en: In this room, only you are moving.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛对着门，你从门进来。
lines.en: My eyes face the door, and you came through it.

lines.zh: 我的影子被钉在底座上，你踩了。
lines.en: My shadow is nailed to this base; you stepped on it.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，往这边来。
lines.en: I count your steps. Coming this way.

lines.zh: 别到我背后去，我看不见那儿。
lines.en: Don't go behind me. I can't see there.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很轻，但我听见了。
lines.en: Your breathing is soft, but I hear it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，剩下的交给别人。
lines.en: I've marked you. The rest is up to others.

lines.zh: 站住。就站那儿。
lines.en: Stop. Right there.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯，晃得我眼晕。
lines.en: That lamp of yours makes my eyes swim.

lines.zh: 好，我记住你的位置了。
lines.en: Good. I've memorized where you are.

lines.zh: 我一直看着那个方向。
lines.en: I keep looking that way.

lines.zh: 你走到左边，我的眼睛跟不到。
lines.en: You moved left; my eyes can't follow.

lines.zh: 我的姿势锁死了视线。
lines.en: My pose locks my line of sight.

lines.zh: 你又回来了，还在原处。
lines.en: You've come back. Still in the same place.

lines.zh: 我在数你走远了几步。
lines.en: I'm counting how many steps away you are.

lines.zh: 这屋里回声很大，你藏不住。
lines.en: This room echoes. You can't hide.

lines.zh: 有人在我身后翻东西。
lines.en: Someone's rummaging behind me.

lines.zh: 你脚边那块地板是空的。
lines.en: The floorboard by your foot is hollow.

lines.zh: 我只能看着，别的做不了。
lines.en: I can only watch. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 你越走越远，我还在看。
lines.en: You're getting further. I'm still watching.

lines.zh: 你绕了一圈，又回到我正前方。
lines.en: You circled and came back to my front.

lines.zh: 我的目光定在门口，你出不去。
lines.en: My gaze is on the door. You won't slip past.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就能看清你的脸。
lines.en: A little closer and I'll see your face.

lines.zh: 这里只有你，和我。
lines.en: Here there is only you, and me.

lines.zh: 我只有五点生命，却一直看着你。
lines.en: Five health points, and I keep watching you.

lines.zh: 我等着，我不着急。
lines.en: I'll wait. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 这间展厅，你是唯一的动静。
lines.en: In this hall you're the only movement.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先知道你来了。
lines.en: My shadow knew you were coming before I did.

lines.zh: 我打不了人，这只是摆的姿势。
lines.en: I can't strike. This is only a pose.

lines.zh: 我的爪子举着，落不下去。
lines.en: My paw is raised and won't come down.

lines.zh: 你要真怕，就退开些。
lines.en: If you're truly afraid, step back.

lines.zh: 这一下没有力道，只是样子。
lines.en: There's no force in it. Only the look.

lines.zh: 我吓到你了？抱歉。
lines.en: Did I frighten you? Sorry.

lines.zh: 这姿势是摆我的人选的。
lines.en: Whoever set me up chose this pose.

lines.zh: 这爪子是铸的，落不下来。
lines.en: This claw is cast; it cannot fall.

lines.zh: 你撞到我举着的手上了。
lines.en: You walked into my raised hand.

lines.zh: 我的手臂很硬，撞上会疼。
lines.en: My arm is hard. It'll hurt to walk into.

lines.zh: 别拿武器砍我，砍坏了没人修。
lines.en: Don't swing at me. Break me and no one will fix it.

lines.zh: 我动不了，你得自己躲。
lines.en: I can't move. You'll have to dodge on your own.

lines.zh: 站远点，我不会追。
lines.en: Stand back. I won't chase.

lines.zh: 这一爪子永远停在半空。
lines.en: This paw will hang in the air forever.

lines.zh: 你躲什么？我根本没动。
lines.en: What are you dodging? I never moved.

lines.zh: 我只剩这个吓人的样子。
lines.en: All I have left is this frightening look.

lines.zh: 你要是打我，我只能挨着。
lines.en: If you hit me, I can only take it.

lines.zh: 有人把我搬进来，摆在这儿。
lines.en: Someone carried me in and set me here.

lines.zh: 我的底座落在木地板上，闷响。
lines.en: My base lands on the boards with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 这个角度，正对着走廊。
lines.en: From this angle I face the corridor.

lines.zh: 他们调了半天，才把我摆正。
lines.en: They fiddled a long while to get me straight.

lines.zh: 布景里需要一个熊，我就来了。
lines.en: The set needed a bear, so here I am.

lines.zh: 灯光打在我身上，我亮了。
lines.en: A light hits me and I brighten.

lines.zh: 这栋楼里，摆件比人多。
lines.en: In this building, ornaments outnumber people.

lines.zh: 我旁边挂着一块旧牌子。
lines.en: An old sign hangs beside me.

lines.zh: 我的姿势是照着照片摆的。
lines.en: My pose was copied from a photograph.

lines.zh: 灰落下来，落在我帽檐上。
lines.en: Dust settles on the brim of my hat.

lines.zh: 我面朝门，背对墙。
lines.en: I face the door, back to the wall.

lines.zh: 这地方叫展览厅，我记住了。
lines.en: They call this place the attraction. I'll remember.

lines.zh: 有人碰了碰我的肩，走开了。
lines.en: Someone touched my shoulder and walked off.

lines.zh: 我成了这里的一部分。
lines.en: I've become part of this place.

lines.zh: 站稳了，我就不再挪动。
lines.en: Set firm, I'll never shift again.

lines.zh: 门开了又关，我一直在这儿。
lines.en: The door opened and shut. I've been here throughout.

lines.zh: 他们说要留个吓人的东西。
lines.en: They said they wanted something scary here.

lines.zh: 我落地的那一刻，房间安静了。
lines.en: The room went quiet the moment I landed.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的布料就卷了。
lines.en: Fire curls my cloth right up.

lines.zh: 我倒下去，摔掉了一只耳朵。
lines.en: I fall and lose an ear.

lines.zh: 水泡进来，我的填料沉了。
lines.en: Water soaks in and my stuffing sags.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀倒，帽子滚远了。
lines.en: The blast knocks me over; my hat rolls away.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我胸口上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的布料发紧。
lines.en: That force pulls my cloth taut.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但摆久了也旧。
lines.en: I don't eat, but standing ages me.

lines.zh: 雷光灌满眼窝，我亮得吓人。
lines.en: Lightning fills my sockets; I glow horribly.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地板，我连站着都做不到。
lines.en: No floor in the void. I can't even stand.
